notes.title: Update: The Tavern
notes.content:
[p]
Hello everyone!

Apologies for not updating for a while ːsteamfacepalmːbut here we are, and we're super excited to share what's coming! [/p][list][*][p] The Tavern & New UI Update[/p][/*][*][p] Additionally, Localization will be moved to the Beta version[/p][/*][*][p] And lastly, our QA team is now onboard for final polishing![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🍖 The Tavern with Food Update![/h2][p][i]Remember this house right here? [/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/8c08e9de289cb406d43fa5d618554c1ce7af92ff.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We’d love to introduce you to our granny at the Tavern![/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b0ebba2e5971a8622fe20416da509caaa0dbde74.png"][/img][/p][p]Now, reaching the outpost no longer heals you to 100% by default. We absolutely love the designs, and we hope you do too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/6e5d44e3cce6dfc1a489a06a993ebf4eef5001c8.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We got.. We've received a lot of feedback about our UI feeling unpolished and in need of improvements. Thanks to your suggestions in the feedback surveys, we’ve made major changes!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/341a8e4535c60254ba801f084f8f04d4a4b5e3b6.png"][/img][i]Of course, the changes apply to the entire game. We hope you're excited to see Northwind looking better than ever. Once everything is complete, we'll share new screenshots and update our entire store page (again!).[/i]
[/p][h2]
🌍 Localization Update[/h2][p] Originally, we planned to include localization in the demo. However, we ran into several language-specific issues. Because of this, we’ve decided to shift our localization efforts to the Early Access version instead.  This means updated tools and language support will be available in the Beta build.

If you're interested in helping us with localization, please let us know!
Reach out to us in [url="https://discord.gg/rMEqbNhkha" style="button"]Discord[/url]  and  [url="https://forms.gle/JrSPXKz26xpC9uYE7" style="button"]Beta Test Registration[/url][/p][p][/p][h2] 🔧 QA [/h2][p]Our QA team is finally in! 🎉 They were originally scheduled to begin in late June, but we needed a bit more time to build internal debugging tools and improve their workflow.  Now that everything is ready, they’ll be helping us test while we continue developing. Once they give us the green light, we’ll be inviting you in![/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks so much for your patience.
We know it’s been a wait. ❤️ ːsteamsadː[/h2][p][/p][p]🚀 [b]We're So Close to Early Access![/b][/p][p]We’ve been pouring our hearts into [i]Northwind[/i], you know when the QA team get serious! You can feel that we are so close to launch! We're both incredibly excited and a little nervous xD We hope you look forwar to it! [b]Thank you so, so much for your continued support, we couldn’t do this without you all![/b][/p][p]

notes.title: Northwind is in TurnBasedThursdayFest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː

Northwind has been selected to be part of Turn-Based Thursday Fest & Southeastasia Games Showcase!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TurnBasedThursdayFest2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/090df12381d0c6b05338084c216ccb946bd385d1.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ac78239149c394002ecc52a1489d57bde66b437b.png[/img][/url]
We’re incredibly humbled to be featured and would love to give you more updates about the game.

[h2]Here are 4 updates we’re excited to share:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Neutral Card+ Version!
[*] Challenge Node
[*] Undead Thief
[*] Localization
[/olist][h3]
Neutral cards can now be Merged/Smelt!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b59b8423ca0fe46ac8cfdf5ada1ae971f75adff0.png[/img]
After careful consideration, we’ve decided that Neutral cards should have access to + versions of their own. This adds even more depth to the game! And yes, some relics will also support Neutral archetypes!

[h3]Introducing Challenge Event[/h3]
We know you enjoy those town Blacksmith and Alchemist upgrades! And what’s even better?
[b]The chance to earn more of those currencies![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/4e9c0f578e1c27e854e2de3762d4d1e1ea4ce379.png[/img]
Challenge Events give you that opportunity, but you’ll have to face a penalty!
Each penalty comes in a different form, so think carefully before you pick one.
[i]Risk it for the reward or play it safe? The choice is yours![/i]

[h3]Beware of the Thief!
[/h3]Introducing the [b]Skeleton Thief[/b]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ea6ec4ff51b33ab3753df95fa3ec37eef3ae45d9.gif[/img]
A sneaky new enemy who may appear during random encounters to steal your currency!
Monster bones? Monster scales?! You’ll be in trouble if you don't take it down!

[h3]Localization Update[/h3]
Thanks to our amazing volunteers, we're getting close to having localized versions of the demo ready!
[list]
[*] German – Translated by [i]Robin Caspers[/i]
[*] French – Translated by [i]Ehless[/i]
[*] Spanish – Translated by [i]Orián "El Gato" Holguera[/i]
[*] Russian – Translated by [i]Elstan Evallyo[/i]
[/list]The official date for the 100% localization update in the demo will be announced soon!

[h2]More updates are coming soon![/h2]
We’re proud to say that [b]100% of our Early Access content is now complete[/b], including all the additional features unlocked through progression and hazard levels. 🎉
Though some can't be shown yet since it's ugly at the moment ːsteamfacepalmː

Right now, we’re fully focused on polishing and cleaning things up. There will definitely be a BETA test, and we’ll be sharing more details with you very soon — stay tuned! :D
[b]If you haven’t registered yet, you can sign up here! 👇👇[/b]
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfWUNm7WNznBpiwYkeQNXrnF9mKHJKQ0TPXBaeGie7JOJdKug/viewform?usp=dialog][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/0930ac4c78901b3d0e6c7f21a05cea92a4579c67.png[/img][/url]

Thank you so much for your support.
We can’t believe and are very excited that we’re closer than ever to launching Northwind in Early Access!
— The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

notes.title: New Demo Gameplay stats.!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

It's been a month since we launched our demo, and as always, we're back to share some exciting gameplay stats! But before that, let’s celebrate some awesome news about our game! 🎉

[h3][b]Northwind now has over 10,000 Wishlists
and more than 7,000 Demo Players! OMG! ːdazed_yetiː [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/c4ae484c390a748a4e9b53c3283e3c5db13111f0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Not to mention, 27 reviews! 🎉[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/05e34698a4dc4aa1b8536727d06bec525c2db6bd.png[/img]

This means so much to us as a small team! 💙 At first, we were a bit reluctant to share this data, but your incredible support has inspired us. We truly believe you’d enjoy celebrating this milestone with us!
Without you playing our game, joining the community, and providing us with valuable feedback, we wouldn’t have come this far. So, from the bottom of our hearts... Thank you! ❤️

[h3][b]Demo Gameplay Stats.[/b][/h3]
This time, we see some similarities with the previous stats on the most-picked cards, but what really changed is the winning deck strategy! The meta has definitely shifted due to the boss this time around.
So, we'll focus on analyzing the winning decks. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d6227eda45e8691baf2cb0809385e19aebd05370.png[/img]

We can really see how you all are now playing more basic card combos and synergies, which makes perfect sense! Feel free to try out some of these cards and combos if you want to defeat the boss or take on Hazard 2!
[list]
[*][i]An interesting stat we found: [b]Basic Attack[/b] is the second most forged card while also being the most removed card using the Wandering Merchant’s service! ːsurprised_yetiː
[*]We're also noticing some fewer plays with [b]Eager Punch[/b] cards!
[*]One of the dev.: Initiate with Focus+ looks super awesome! How did we miss that?! ːlaughing_yetiː [/i][/list]We are aware that some players feel restricted by this boss's strategy, while others feel encouraged to build decks they wouldn’t have considered before—especially using basic cards.
We'll definitely look into this more! We believe one of the charms of having multiple bosses in Northwind is that each one's unique characteristics can push you to build something you never imagined, while still being flexible enough for you to defeat them with your own crafted deck!

[i](By the way, The Warlord was intended to be among the easiest bosses..
What are your thoughts? Do you find the challenge exciting, or does it discourage you from playing? 
Let us know!)[/i]

Link to our Previous Demo Gameplay Stats! (Back then, the boss was [b]Silverfangs[/b], not [b]The Warlord![/b])
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1476400/view/4193491470659656247?l=english

[h3]🔎 More Feedback & Suggestions We've Received:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix the Controls! – Selecting our character for some card effects feels weird. Why not auto-select or allow clicking on equipment directly if needed? 
[i][b]= We couldn't agree more! This is at the top of our fix list.
[/b][/i][*] More Juiciness, Animations, & Effects!
[i][b]= This is something we definitely want to improve! The level of "juiciness" depends on player expectations, but we'll do our best to enhance the experience as much as possible.[/b][/i]
[*] More Languages!
[i][b]= Yes! We plan to add more localization in the future. We’ll announce the supported languages soon!
[/b][/i][*] Content Feedback: – Card archetypes, Legacy Points, and Hazard Level progression don’t feel impactful enough.
[i][b]= We hear you! Since this is just a demo, we haven’t revealed all of our content yet, but your feedback has given us new ideas on how to improve progression. We hope you look forward to our Early Access Version![/b][/i][/list]
[b][h3]What’s Happening with the Demo and Early Access Version?[/h3]
[/b]Our current plan is to focus on the Early Access launch, which we’re aiming for in Q3 2025! 🎉
(We need to make it happen this year, seriously!) As for the demo, we plan to keep it live for a while—possibly until the Early Access release. However, we won’t be releasing any major updates, except for localization fixes and additional supported languages.

[b][h3]🔥 Pyrotech Playtesting[/h3]
[/b]We’ll probabyl need playtesters soon!
[b]If you’re interested in helping us balance her out, CLICK THE BANNER TO REGISTER! 👇👇👇
[/b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfWUNm7WNznBpiwYkeQNXrnF9mKHJKQ0TPXBaeGie7JOJdKug/viewform?usp=dialog][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/0930ac4c78901b3d0e6c7f21a05cea92a4579c67.png[/img][/url]

[b][h3]Localization is about to start![/h3][/b]It's been delayed, but we think it will be ready by the end of March. We've been working hard to improve the quality-of-life (QoL) features for our localizers, and now the system is ready! 🎉 If you’d like to help us out, join our Discord! 💬
[b]CLICK THE BANNER TO JOIN! 👇👇👇[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/rMEqbNhkha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/0c228f03353fc8a98916c311d504f7113c91d7eb.png[/img]
[/url]
[h3]Thank you! Again, we truly appreciate your support. 🙏
[/h3]Slowly but surely, Northwind is becoming a game we never imagined we could create! The feedback we’ve received has been incredibly encouraging, pushing us to make it even better. 💙 Thank you!
— The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

notes.title: What's new in this DEMO?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h1]🎉 Our demo is now available! 🎉[/h1]
After reviewing all the feedback from the previous demo, we’ve put together an improved version of the game. Let us share what's new and why you should play it!

[h3]Check out our New Trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=LlsgrWDe32A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Boss Enters the Arena![/h3]
Being a monster-hunting roguelite deckbuilder means facing multiple bosses.
If you played our previous demo, you fought Silverfangs! But now, we’re introducing "The Warlord"! (Defeat him if you can...)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/5f4e9443505fbfc9b9cf3578ee71c5616faaa530.png[/img]

[h3]Revamped Map Nodes (Visual & Game Design)![/h3]
Based on your feedback, we noticed some routes felt repetitive and unexciting. We've redesigned the map, adding new event types and visual upgrades to make each run more engaging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ba52df371ba26349ca4a0b39317aec4b2529e56c.png[/img]

[h3]Improved UX/UI for Clarity![/h3]
Many players found certain mechanics confusing, like Rampage, so we've renamed it to Countdown and added clearer animations when it triggers. We've also improved feedback for when monsters add Curse cards, so you’ll always know how they entered your deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/bb4f5c1fdac67d62e33cfb57429ca3f83a42911a.png[/img]

[h3]Speed Mode & Hazard Levels for Veterans![/h3]
We heard you—the game felt too slow for experienced players! This update introduces Speed Mode and Hazard Levels to increase difficulty for those looking for more challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/152d2795d0bbf98a4c96aae9efa14244e8a70bba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/1f7c9f48970709c532ea2b906a778c3767b897d7.png[/img]

Thai is now available! Other languages will follow soon!
Once the demo goes public, we'll be sharing some files for localization as well as wiki!
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rMEqbNhkha]Discord[/url] if you'd like to help us with localization! 🌍✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/7fb5b6bad7fb94c58d14b1d7726351740896026f.png[/img]

[h3]Visual Improvements & Much More![/h3]
You’ll notice new cards, removed/adjusted relics, and overall balancing improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/178759f5d8e2258476b024cf73f68cbe95cf0ccc.png[/img]

[h2]Beta Test Registration is Now Open![/h2]
With our Early Access launch getting closer, we’re now opening Beta Test Registration!

📢 Let us know what you think about our demo! Help us make Northwind better!

notes.title: New Update: Turn-Based Carnival
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

[b]We’re honored to announce that we’ve been selected for the Turnbased Carnival! 🎉
[/b]If you enjoy turn-based games, check out the other incredible games featured there!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Acram/sale/turn-basedcarnival2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ff217742c2101d96f1167d8433ac38d86b13ced9.png[/img]
[/url]
We’d also like to take this opportunity to update you on our progress and share some of the exciting features we’ve been working on. Here are some highlights:

[h2]Countdown Token Replaces Rampage ⏳[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/536e8d0360583eeebc9d2321170a1d36177f555c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Is that a new UI!?[/b][/h3]
Yes! We’ve implemented a cleaner, more intuitive UI to make combat easier to understand.
Look forward to a brand new tutorial!

As for Rampage: Many players were confused about when Rampage would trigger...
Was it immediate or on the next turn??? We’ve replaced Rampage with a Countdown token, which triggers the special move once it reaches 0. [i](Not the official icon design)[/i]

[h3][b]This new mechanic lets you strategize and manage countdowns!
[/b][/h3]Use certain cards, relics, and perks to alter or delay enemy special moves. Plan your moves carefully!
(Fun Fact: The card [b]Taming Technique[/b] was designed by one of our interns!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d3140734a9b2d50d4d1c3c9897532366722c8084.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b8b24e401cf430f77130a804ebb11a01b8bd7a6c.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Blacksmith Section 🔨[/h2]
We’ve revamped the Blacksmith to make navigating Merge, Forge, and Fuse services easier for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ce2c5f2fcccca7cb7718676550c23c7db8a01af6.png[/img]
This includes adding blueprints to craft certain cards, so players have more clarity and control when upgrading their decks. We hope this helps you optimize your strategy seamlessly.

[h2]Moo Deng  🐾[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/cbd17f692425301aac2881baa148c54bc9da6d67.png[/img]
The pygmy hippo will be part of the perks in the game! 🎉
(In case you haven’t heard of Moo Deng, she’s a global sensation—a pygmy hippo from Thailand!)

[h2]Localization Delay 🌐[/h2]
As we implement updates, especially the new Countdown token, we’ve decided to delay localization for some languages until these mechanics are finalized. We apologize for not reaching out to our volunteers at this time; we want to ensure the game is more stable before reconnecting with them/you.

These are just a few of the exciting changes coming your way, with much more to come.
Thank you so much for your patience and support! ːheart_eyes_yetiː

The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

notes.title: Devlog#13 Cooking Demo...
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while, but we've been working tirelessly on our public demo, and before we bid farewell to this year, we wanted to share our progress! ːdazed_yetiː

Based on your invaluable feedback, we've implemented a ton of changes in the game.
This includes both design and UX improvements!

[h2]🔥 Now, let's dive into the updates:[/h2]

[h3]Card Merging: You can now merge similar cards! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/de4acd1408e523f5c70384bf5868e73baa89d07d.png[/img]
If you have duplicate cards, you can combine them to unlock even more powerful effects. This upgraded version is called the '+' version. Each card's effect varies, and we encourage you to discover all of them because some can be really powerful!

[h3]Gem Upgrades: Each card can now have a maximum of 1 gem upgrade.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/63fd9abec7a3d6cffb0f33f57e32124172fa3e4d.png[/img]
We recognize that cards with two gem upgrades can become overly powerful, so we've now limited upgrades to one gem per card. However, if you merge two cards, each with a gem, the resulting merged card will have two gems! Isn't that cool? 💎

[i]But take note: we've implemented new merging price conditions. The cost for each card now varies depending on its rarity, the gems attached, and other factors. So, make sure you have enough resources![/i]

[h3]New Roguelite Progression: Experience Points and Town Points.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/3d9d94c723b2cec44abfb44bd545aa33ec0c7ccd.png[/img]
Our previous pre-demo roguelite progression isn't that impactful.
So, we've split it into two types: Experience Points and Town Points.

[list]
[*] [b]Experience Points[/b]: Unlock new cards and relics immediately upon collecting enough points. 
[*] [b]Town Points[/b]: Use these to purchase upgrades in town, which can significantly change your playstyle. If you're fond of the 'Merge' system, you can choose to upgrade the Blacksmith. Alternatively, if gems are more your style, the 'Alchemist' is also available. Additionally, if you're looking to better manage your resources, there are upgrades available for that as well.
[/list]
[h2]That's it for now...[/h2]
**Spoiler: Undead Slime**
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/6dd98a6339a30cda540329a7cbdb1cd5896bc8ad.gif[/img]

There are many more changes we've made, but let's save some surprises for later.
We think the Demo should be available by the end of February or March so stay tuned!

And like always we'll have LIVE TESTER (Should be around the beginning of February!)
Thank you for your incredible support! ːheart_eyes_yetiː
The Northwind team, Barking Kitten Interactive. 🐾

notes.title: Alpha Test Feedback.
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, I want to say thank you for playing our Alpha. ːheart_eyes_yetiː
Just by you playing or quitting the game really tell us how much fixing is needed to make this game fun.
And for people, you help us with the [b]survey[/b], [b]interview[/b], and [b]LIVE tester[/b]. [i]Thank you so so much. [/i]

This allows us to know what is the real problem in our game and make sure to have it solved before releasing.

[h2]Let's start with some stats.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d6fc36b52cbce62f07f0b05b9f430e21b55ee10b.png[/img]

[b]Honorable mention cards:[/b] Eagerpunch and Strafing.
[b]0% Pick rate: Transcendence.[/b] (Super shocking; we dev. think it is super powerful.)
[b]Players hate Boss Act 1:[/b] most players lose the game and don't get to experience the town system.

[h2]What will be fix/change?[/h2]

[b]According to the feedback from our Alpha Test. (List that needs fixing).
[/b][list]
[*] Control needs to be smoother. (Throw, click, slide, cancel, etc.)
[*] A lot of UX/UI.
[*] The tutorial is unfriendly, and some players are still confused about the game.
[*] Monster power spike and difficulty is a big problem.
[*] Cards synergy can be better.
[*] Aura-type monsters are annoying.
[*] Request/Need a lot of visual feedback, icons, animation, etc.
[/list][b]So, after a long discussion, here are things we can confirm.[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendlier Tutorial and UX/UI.
[*] Control will be smoother.
[*] Add more impactful relics and gems.
[*] Adjust randomness in the map node and more unique Events.
[*] Roguelite progressions will be added.
[*] Fight animations, VFX, and animation feedback will be added.
[*] Spoiler: Big changes in the ITEM system (Too STS at the moment, we'll make it Northwind style).
[*] [b]And many more! I don't want to spoil all the goods, so see for yourself in our Demo! ːsteammockingː[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Demo and Early Access launch date.[/h2]
We need to move our launch date. We initially expected to launch our game around June, but after careful consideration... the game won't be up to our standard, or at least we believe you won't be happy with that quality.

So... this is just a rough estimation.
[list]
[b][*] The Demo should be available in August.
[*] Early Access... probably Q4. (We'll announce officially again when the date is near.)[/b][/list]Unfortunately, we need to move the date, but we believe it's the best for the game. ːcrying_yetiː

[h2]Message from the Developers.[/h2]
Some players wrote us essays, some played the game for over 10Hrs+, and some DM me regularly with all the things they find frustrating.

Thank you for your time and feedback; we read every single word.
This means so much to us; we feel Northwind has received so much love and care.
We are thankful, humbled, and appreciate all the time and effort you've given us. 
Your words help us make a better version of Northwind. We will work hard not to disappoint all of you.

Thank you for reading, have a great day! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Starting Deck
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Finally, after fixing tons of bugs and testing, we are now working on balancing! ːsteamhappyː
Our team loves challenges, so we will be leaning towards designing a hardcore/difficult game. ːsteammockingː
But don't worry! We'll make sure people who are new to deckbuilding can still enjoy the experience. :heart_eyes_yeti:

[h2]Introducing Sword Mastery and your Starting Deck[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/f06d1e0c59300916957cc3daade4f60aa2f08571.png[/img]
[i]Let's just call him "Swordman" for the time being.
He will be your first mercenary, and this is his starting deck.[/i]
[list]
[*][b] 5 Sword Mastery[/b] - Mainly provides you sufficient AP to play cards.
[*][b] 5 Slash[/b] - Main source of attack power.
[*][b] 1 Leather Glove[/b] - Provide you buff for the rest of the battle.
[*][b] 1 Suckerpunch[/b] - Hmm.. let's say your first powerful card, a small taste of synergy. :laughing_yeti:[/list] Every time you win a battle of course you'll get to...
Pick 1/3 cards [b]AND[/b] You can choose whether you want to add 1 Sword Mastery into your deck.

Why? Sword Mastery card has the keyword, [b]Source.[/b]
[b]Source[/b]: [i]When put in your hand, give you AP.[/i]

With this system, you'll get to personalize the amount of AP you'll get from your deck.
There's more to it. You could even merge, transform it, and so on!? :surprised_yeti:

[h2]Monster Update[/h2]
[h3]That annoying monster in the game...[/h3]
Seem like we need some annoying monster that irritates you, yet without it, you'll find the game losing its charm. :happy_yeti: We also started looking into each monster attack effect, and we asked our Twitter followers to see what they thought, and it turns out that A2 and A4 are the most loved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/93f117159ef97d8f97297fce5874fe94ebbcc900.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/1b501f99446f79819e4d5a5e2e8767751e818dd5.gif[/img]
[h3]How Gore?[/h3]
We have undead so... how gore will our game be? :laughing_yeti:
Not much but enough to creep you out when you meet these elites!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/44aea89a8eb89da7c4f75aea029e92bb77cbd5cf.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]
We'll do everything we can to make our game as fun and unique as possible.
We believe it will take a long time to develop, we only have three people working on this game full-time. Despite that, we are determined to pull it off!
Thank you for reading, and as always have a wonderful weekend! ːsteamthumbsupː
